consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: control of freeboard, beach width and decant

hazard_media: stored potential of an elevated component
facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: stored energy found after isolation of HT-9002

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EMBANKMENT_SURVEILLANCE: the surveillance of embankments and instrumentation was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control IMPOUNDMENT_FREEBOARD_CONTROL: the control of freeboard, beach width and decant was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the surveillance of embankments and instrumentation on HT-9002 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the control of freeboard, beach width and decant on HT-9002 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in operating an impoundment, specifically inspecting embankments and instrumentation. HT-9002 (haul trucks) is in service for waste and ore haulage. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the surveillance of embankments and instrumentation was not in place. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 19 August 2012 a hazard report was recorded on HT-9002 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during cleaning and preparation; gravity energy held as suspended load was not released.
